description: This file defines the Style class responsible for parsing and managing style information from XML in the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically handling style attributes such as alignment, borders, font, fill, number format, and protection.

classes.name: Style
classes.description: A class for parsing and storing style information from XML in the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: parseStyles
methods.description: Parses style definitions from an XML element and returns an array of styles.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attributes from a SimpleXMLElement, returning an empty XML element if input is null.

methods.name: getSxml
methods.description: Returns the input SimpleXMLElement or an empty XML element if input is null.
